sub_graphs.title: SECP256K1 Signature Recovery Process
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime behavior of recovering public keys from ECDSA signatures on the secp256k1 curve

nodes.label: Signature Components Received
nodes.description: System has received r, s, v signature components and message hash for recovery

nodes.label: Validate R Coordinate On Curve
nodes.description: Verify that r represents a valid x-coordinate on secp256k1 using Legendre symbol computation

nodes.label: R Coordinate Validated
nodes.description: The r value has been confirmed as a valid curve point x-coordinate

nodes.label: R Coordinate Invalid
nodes.description: The r value is not a valid x-coordinate on the curve

nodes.label: Construct 65-byte Signature
nodes.description: Construct 65-byte signature array from r, s, v components for recovery algorithm

nodes.label: Execute ECDSA Recovery
nodes.description: Execute coincurve library recovery algorithm to extract public key from signature

nodes.label: Public Key Recovered
nodes.description: Uncompressed public key has been successfully recovered (64 bytes, prefix excluded)

nodes.label: Recovery Failed
nodes.description: Public key recovery failed due to invalid signature or point-at-infinity result

edges.label: Point not on curve - raise InvalidSignatureError

external_entities.name: Signature Provider
external_entities.description: External source providing ECDSA signature components (e.g., transaction signer, message signer)

sub_graphs.title: SECP256R1 (P-256) Signature Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime behavior of verifying P-256 ECDSA signatures for precompile contracts

nodes.label: P-256 Verification Input Received
nodes.description: System has received signature (r,s), public key (x,y), and message hash for P-256 verification

nodes.label: Validate Point on P-256 Curve
nodes.description: Verify that public key coordinates (x,y) satisfy curve equation y² ≡ x³ + ax + b (mod p)

nodes.label: Point Valid on Curve
nodes.description: Public key point confirmed to lie on the P-256 curve

nodes.label: Point Not on Curve
nodes.description: Public key point does not satisfy curve equation

nodes.label: Convert to DER Encoding
nodes.description: Convert signature parameters to DER-encoded format for cryptographic backend

nodes.label: Execute ECDSA Verification
nodes.description: Execute cryptographic verification using prehashed SHA256 algorithm

nodes.label: Signature Verified
nodes.description: ECDSA signature has been cryptographically verified as valid

nodes.label: Signature Invalid
nodes.description: ECDSA verification failed - raise InvalidSignatureError

external_entities.name: Precompile Caller
external_entities.description: Smart contract or external caller invoking the P-256 signature verification precompile

sub_graphs.title: Elliptic Curve Cryptographic Error Handling
sub_graphs.description: Models error conditions and rejection paths in elliptic curve operations

nodes.label: Cryptographic Operation Started
nodes.description: An elliptic curve cryptographic operation has been initiated

nodes.label: Validate Input Bounds
nodes.description: Check that input values are within valid bounds for the curve parameters

nodes.label: Input Bounds Valid
nodes.description: All input values are within acceptable ranges for curve arithmetic

nodes.label: Perform Modular Arithmetic
nodes.description: Execute curve operations modulo the respective field prime (SECP256K1P or SECP256R1P)

nodes.label: Point at Infinity Detected
nodes.description: Recovery algorithm returned point-at-infinity, indicating invalid result

nodes.label: Raise InvalidSignatureError
nodes.description: Raise InvalidSignatureError exception to signal cryptographic validation failure

nodes.label: Error Propagated to Caller
nodes.description: InvalidSignatureError has been raised and propagated to the calling context

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly define behavior when v (recovery identifier) is outside expected range [0, 1, 27, 28]
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the coincurve library handles invalid v values and raises appropriate errors. This needs verification against library behavior.

ambiguities.text: The term 'valid x-coordinate' in Legendre symbol validation is not precisely defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'valid' means the value x satisfies: x³ + 7 (mod p) is a quadratic residue, allowing recovery of a y-coordinate on the curve.

implicit_assumptions.description: The coincurve library implementation is assumed to be cryptographically correct and secure
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect ECDSA operations could allow signature forgery or public key recovery attacks

implicit_assumptions.description: All arithmetic is performed modulo respective field primes, assuming no integer overflow in underlying implementation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Integer overflow could lead to incorrect curve point calculations and signature validation bypass

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot find collisions in the message hash that would allow signature reuse across different messages
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Hash collisions could enable signature forgery without knowing the private key
